services.name: Kott-the-Limit Fishing Charters
services.desc: Whether you're new to the sport or an eager angler, your day on the water is sure to be fun and educational. Kott-the-Limit Sport Fishing is a family owned and operated private fishing charter boat docked in Ocean City, New Jersey. We'll treat your family like our own. Run by Captain Bill Kott and Captain Bill Kott

gap: Price per trip or per person not stated
blurb: Guests fish offshore for tuna and sharks, and in back bays for flounder (fluke) and stripers. The charter uses a 23-foot Parker boat with 360 degrees of fishability. Captains are U.S. Coast Guard licensed and experienced, with a focus on family-friendly and educational fishing experiences.
extraNote: Reservations confirmed by trip deposit · Captain determines all cancellations due to sea conditions · Charters cancelled due to weather or reasons beyond control will be rescheduled or deposit refunded if rescheduling not possible · Guests will be contacted the night before if weather is unfavorable · Firearms are absolutely not permitted · Liquor and illegal drugs not permitted; beer allowed in moderation but no glass bottles · If a guest becomes intoxicated after departure, trip will be cancelled with no refund · Docked in Ocean City, New Jersey
